en.headline: Oxfam Trailwalker begins in Sai Kung with nearly 4800 participants
en.dek: The 41st edition of the 100km fundraising race started at 8am from Pak Tam Chung under cold and wet conditions.

zh.headline: 樂施會毅行者西貢起步 近4800人參加百公里籌款賽
zh.dek: 第41屆樂施會毅行者百公里籌款賽周五早上8時於西貢北潭涌起步，近4800人參與。

en.headline: The Big Picnic returns to Discovery Bay beach after seven years
en.dek: The festival runs 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. on Saturday at Tai Pak Beach with more than 24 live acts, food stalls and a makers market.

zh.headline: The Big Picnic沙灘音樂節時隔七年重返愉景灣
zh.dek: 活動周六上午11時至晚上10時於大白灣沙灘舉行，超過24組現場演出，並設美食攤檔及手作市集。

en.headline: Observatory issues Strong Monsoon Signal for northerly winds
en.dek: The signal is in force from 4:45 a.m. with strong northerly winds expected and occasional gale-force gusts.

zh.headline: 天文台發出強烈季候風信號 吹偏北強風
zh.dek: 信號於上午4時45分生效，預料平均風速每小時超過40公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。

en.headline: Hong Kong WinterFest opens with winter wonderlands in Central and Tsim Sha Tsui
en.dek: The Hong Kong Tourism Board’s annual festival began on 18 November with light installations and a Christmas town at Statue Square, running through 5 January.

zh.headline: 香港冬日節開幕 中環及尖沙咀冬日仙境亮相
zh.dek: 旅發局年度旗艦活動「香港冬日節」于11月18日開幕，香港冬日仙境首次擴展至三大熱點，展期至明年1月5日。

en.headline: Observatory forecasts urban temperatures down to 14 degrees under northeast monsoon
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said cloudy skies with rain patches will bring appreciably cooler conditions today, with wind chill making it feel colder especially in the New Territories.

zh.headline: 天文台料強烈東北季候風下市區氣溫降至14度
zh.dek: 香港天文台表示，受強烈東北季候風及雲雨帶影響，本港今日顯著轉涼，密雲有幾陣雨，風寒效應令體感更冷，新界部分地區及高地寒冷。

en.headline: Korean illustration brands gather for limited pop-up at D2 Place in Lai Chi Kok
en.dek: The neomu neomu pop-up brings eight Korean illustration brands, several making their Hong Kong debut, to D2 Place TWO until 22 November with plush toys, charms and stationery.

zh.headline: 韓國插畫品牌期間限定店登陸荔枝角D2 Place
zh.dek: neomu neomu韓國文創快閃店匯集八個韓國插畫品牌，部分首次來港，於荔枝角D2 Place二期地下展至11月22日，售賣毛絨玩具及文具。

en.headline: Tsuen Wan's long-shuttered Ting Tai shop opens briefly for kitchenware sale
en.dek: The ground-floor unit on Sha Tsui Road linked to a 1949-era milk-tea brand held a two-hour pop-up sale of enamel pots and pans on Thursday afternoon.

zh.headline: 荃灣長年關閉的鼎泰店舖周四短暫開放廚具特賣
zh.dek: 沙咀道地下舖位與1949年港式奶茶品牌相關，周四下午舉行兩小時倉庫式特賣，出售琺瑯鍋和平底鑊。

en.headline: Building maintenance council to receive HK$413 million and hire 160 staff
en.dek: The Development Bureau said the new body will complete registration next month and focus subsidies on 80 percent of older private buildings after the Tai Po fire.

zh.headline: 樓宇維修支援及服務局獲撥4.13億元 擬聘160人
zh.dek: 發展局表示新機構下月完成註冊，資助將集中於八成樓齡30年或以上私樓，因應大埔宏福苑大火後改革。

en.headline: Government probes repeated signal faults near HKU station after two-day delays
en.dek: The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department has begun an investigation while officials demand a full report from the MTR on causes and improvements.

zh.headline: 港大站連兩日信號故障 政府促港鐵徹查機電署展開調查
zh.dek: 機電工程署已派員到場調查，初步顯示不涉鐵路安全，政府要求港鐵全面報告成因及改善措施。

en.headline: CFS suspends poultry imports from areas in Norway, Britain and Netherlands
en.dek: The Centre for Food Safety acted after World Organisation for Animal Health notifications of highly pathogenic H5N1 outbreaks in the three locations.

zh.headline: 食安中心暫停挪威、英國及荷蘭部分地區禽肉產品進口
zh.dek: 食物安全中心接獲世界動物衞生組織有關高致病性H5N1禽流感爆發的通知後，即時採取行動。

en.headline: Police hunt male staff member after HK$1.88 million camera theft at Times Square Fortress
en.dek: Sixty-one cameras and 55 lenses went missing from the Causeway Bay electronics store; officers are seeking a man aged about 40 who works there.

zh.headline: 時代廣場豐澤失188萬元相機鏡頭 警追緝約40歲男職員
zh.dek: 銅鑼灣電器店有61部相機及55個鏡頭不翼而飛，警方正追緝一名年約40歲的店舖職員。

en.headline: Dinosaur fossil exhibition featuring Port Island finds opens free at Kowloon Park
en.dek: The show at the Hong Kong Heritage Discovery Centre runs until 12 May next year and includes a touchable femur plus 34 first-class protected fossils from the mainland.

zh.headline: 赤洲恐龍化石展今起九龍公園免費開放 可觸摸巨型股骨
zh.dek: 香港文物探知館「見龍在田」展覽展至明年5月12日，展出港產化石及34組國家一級保護內地標本。

en.headline: Against Child Abuse records 216 suspected cases involving 241 children last year
en.dek: Children aged three to five formed the largest group among the cases, with more than 70 per cent of alleged abusers being family members, the organisation said.

zh.headline: 防止虐待兒童會上年度錄得216宗懷疑虐兒個案涉241名兒童
zh.dek: 3至5歲兒童佔最多，超過七成懷疑施虐者為家庭成員，機構指家長壓力大及缺乏管教支援是主因。

en.headline: Man dies after collapsing at Kwai Fong minibus stop
en.dek: Rescuers performed cardiopulmonary resuscitation on the man who fell unconscious near New Town Plaza before he was taken to Yan Chai Hospital, where he was certified dead.

zh.headline: 葵芳新都會廣場小巴站男子暈倒送院後不治
zh.dek: 救援人員在行人路邊輪流為事主進行心外壓，其後送往仁濟醫院，最終證實不治。

en.headline: New World shareholders criticise rights issue at annual general meeting
en.dek: Hundreds of investors queued outside the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre to question the HK$24.9 billion plan that would dilute their holdings unless they subscribe.

zh.headline: 新世界發展股東在股東周年大會批評供股計劃
zh.dek: 數百名投資者在會展中心外排隊，質疑249億元供股若不全數認購將大幅攤薄持股。

en.headline: Alibaba reports 10 percent revenue rise and 92 percent jump in adjusted profit
en.dek: The e-commerce group said cloud and AI revenue surged, though adjusted profit missed estimates and free cash flow stayed negative amid heavy infrastructure spending.

zh.headline: 阿里巴巴季度收入升10% 經調整純利大增92%
zh.dek: 電商集團指雲端及人工智能收入急升，惟經調整盈利低於預期，基建投資下自由現金流仍為流出。

en.headline: deTour design festival opens Friday at PMQ with free entry through November 29
en.dek: PMQ hosts the annual design event under the theme Better, Not Perfect, featuring 14 works by local and international creators plus a pop-up shop.

zh.headline: deTour設計節周五於元創方開幕 免費入場至11月29日
zh.dek: PMQ元創方主辦年度設計盛事，主題「不完美，更美好」，展出14件本地及海外作品，並設快閃選物店。

en.headline: High Court jury convicts man of murdering yoga instructor ex-girlfriend
en.dek: A unanimous High Court jury found Lo Chun-ming guilty of murdering Chow Wai-yin at the Ritz-Carlton hotel in 2022; sentencing is set for Friday.

zh.headline: 高院陪審團一致裁定前男友謀殺瑜伽導師罪成
zh.dek: 高等法院陪審團周四一致裁定勞浚銘謀殺前女友周慧賢罪成，案發於2022年麗思卡爾頓酒店，判刑押後至周五。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 453 points lower at 22841
en.dek: The benchmark fell 1.95 percent for a third straight day as Tencent dropped nearly 7 percent after results and Alibaba slid about 6 percent.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收市跌453點報22841點
zh.dek: 恒指連跌第三日，跌幅1.95%，騰訊績後急挫近7%，阿里巴巴跌約6%。

en.headline: Mark Six campaign could raise next Tuesday snowball jackpot to HK$80 million
en.dek: The Jockey Club said the Hype Up. Jackpot Up. scheme for the lottery’s 50th anniversary will add a larger snowball if turnover reaches HK$70 million by Monday.

zh.headline: 六合彩「Hype Up. Jackpot Up.」活動可將下周二雪球獎金推高至8000萬
zh.dek: 賽馬會指，為慶祝六合彩50周年推出的計劃，若周一前投注額達7000萬元，將增加較大雪球金額。

en.headline: HSBC lets customers use RedCoin for tokenised HKD money market fund
en.dek: Starting Thursday, customers can invest from HK$100 in a new tokenised share class of the HSBC Global Money Funds using the bank’s licensed stablecoin.

zh.headline: 滙豐容許客戶以RedCoin認購代幣化港元貨幣基金
zh.dek: 由周四起，客戶可用最少100港元等值的滙豐穩定幣，認購滙豐環球貨幣基金港元的新代幣化股份類別。

en.headline: John Lee pledges deeper GBA integration and faster Northern Metropolis after meeting Xi
en.dek: The Chief Executive outlined strategies for cross-border mobility and infrastructure after speaking with the Chinese President at the APEC summit in Shenzhen.

zh.headline: 李家超會晤習近平後承諾深化大灣區融合及加快北部都會區
zh.dek: 行政長官在深圳亞太經合組織峰會後，闡述透過基建、規則銜接及跨境流動推進融合的策略。

en.headline: WIPO pledges deeper IP cooperation as Hong Kong expands financing and patent review
en.dek: At the Business of IP Asia Forum, the UN agency said it would help the city on dispute resolution and commercialisation while the finance chief outlined plans for a regional trading centre.

zh.headline: 世界知識產權組織深化與港合作 陳茂波推融資及專利審查
zh.dek: 在亞洲知識產權營商論壇上，聯合國機構表示願協助本港處理爭議解決及商業化，財政司司長則闡述建設區域貿易中心的計劃。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index falls 439 points to 22855 at midday below 23000
en.dek: The benchmark dropped 1.89 percent by noon as Tencent and Alibaba led losses among blue chips, with main board turnover near HK$123 billion.

zh.headline: 恒生指數半日跌439點失守23000點
zh.dek: 恒指中午報22855點，跌1.89%，騰訊及阿里巴巴領跌藍籌，半日主板成交額近1234億元。

en.headline: Police arrest 123 in phone scam and money laundering operation
en.dek: The Commercial Crime Bureau and districts cracked 108 cases involving about HK$68 million and raided two industrial building call centres in Hung Hom and Kwun Tong.

zh.headline: 警方打擊電話騙案及洗黑錢拘123人
zh.dek: 商業罪案調查科聯同各警區偵破108宗案件涉款約6800萬元，搞破紅磡及觀塘兩間工廈詐騙電話操作中心。

en.headline: Star Ferry Car Park to cease operations and be demolished after new site opens
en.dek: The Transport Department said the multi-storey car park on Edinburgh Place will close once public parking spaces at Central Site 3 enter service, with monthly rentals shifting from January.

zh.headline: 天星碼頭停車場將於新海濱泊車位啟用後停止營運並拆卸
zh.dek: 運輸署表示，中環愛丁堡廣場的天星碼頭停車場待三號用地公眾泊車位投入服務後便會關閉拆卸，明年一月起季租改為月租。

en.headline: CUHK Medical Centre apologises after doctor removes patient's ovaries by mistake
en.dek: The hospital said an experienced surgeon suffered a lapse in concentration during a September operation intended only to remove the uterus and fallopian tubes; the patient remains stable.

zh.headline: 中大醫院就醫生誤切病人卵巢致歉
zh.dek: 院方指經驗豐富的外科醫生在九月手術中短暫失神，原計劃只切除子宮及輸卵管，病人情況穩定。

en.headline: MTR Island Line delayed again by HKU station signal fault
en.dek: The operator said a signalling fault near HKU station added five to eight minutes to journeys for about an hour during Thursday morning rush hour before services returned to normal.

zh.headline: 港鐵港島綫香港大學站信號故障連續兩日影響繁忙時間
zh.dek: 港鐵表示，周四早上香港大學站附近信號故障令整體車程額外增加五至八分鐘，約一小時後修復，服務陸續恢復正常。

en.headline: PETIT FACTORY Christmas installation opens at Kai Tak Cullinan Sky Mall
en.dek: The Korean brand's first Hong Kong Christmas theme features a 4.5-metre clock tower, starlight displays and pop-up shop until early January.

zh.headline: 啟德天璽天Mall呈獻PETIT FACTORY聖誕星光夢工場
zh.dek: 韓國療癒系品牌首度登陸香港，設近4.5米鐘樓、星光裝置及快閃店，展期至1月3日。

en.headline: Police receive 216 reports totaling HK$38 million over closed luxury consignment shops
en.dek: Reports concerning Vootic in Causeway Bay and Obsessplanet in Admiralty rose sharply, with police classifying the cases as fraud and seeking a Japanese owner.

zh.headline: 警方接獲216宗報案涉款3800萬 兩間名牌寄賣店結業
zh.dek: 銅鑼灣Vootic及金鐘樂星寄賣店結業後報案人數急增，警方暫列欺詐，正追緝日籍負責人。

en.headline: Temperatures drop under northeast monsoon as Hong Kong turns cooler
en.dek: The Observatory said morning readings were generally three to four degrees lower than yesterday, with urban lows around 18 degrees tonight and further falls expected tomorrow.

zh.headline: 東北季候風影響下香港氣溫下降天氣轉涼
zh.dek: 天文台指今早各區氣溫普遍較昨日低三至四度，晚上市區最低約18度，明日進一步下降。

en.headline: HKU completes Asia's first histotripsy treatments for kidney cancer
en.dek: Two patients with early-stage tumours were treated without incision using focused ultrasound and discharged the next day without complications.

zh.headline: 港大完成亞洲首兩宗組織碎化技術治療腎癌
zh.dek: 兩名早期腫瘤病人接受無創聚焦超聲波治療，翌日出院，未見併發症。

en.headline: HKTDC Entrepreneur Day opens at Convention Centre with startup showcases
en.dek: The two-day event under the theme Where Start-up Dreams Take Flight runs until Friday with more than 370 exhibitors and free admission for registered visitors.

zh.headline: 香港貿發局創業日於會展開幕展示初創方案
zh.dek: 以「初創夢啟航」為主題的兩日活動至周五舉行，預計逾370家參展商，已登記訪客免費入場。

en.headline: DesignInspire opens to public today at Convention and Exhibition Centre
en.dek: The free design exhibition under the Wander and Wonder theme runs until 21 November with over 200 exhibitors from 17 countries.

zh.headline: DesignInspire創意設計博覽今日開放公眾參觀
zh.dek: 以Wander & Wonder為主題的免費設計展覽於灣仔會展舉行至11月21日，匯聚17個國家及地區逾200個參展商。

en.headline: Hong Kong drops criminal damage charge against ship captain over Baltic pipeline
en.dek: Prosecutors withdrew the case against Wan Wenguo after failing to contact mainland witnesses; he pleaded guilty to lesser offences and is expected to leave for the mainland.

zh.headline: 港方撤銷船長破壞波羅的海管道刑事控罪
zh.dek: 控方因未能聯絡內地證人而撤銷針對萬文國的刑事毀壞控罪，他承認較輕微罪行後預計返回內地。

en.headline: Pingu Christmas ice village opens at Tsim Sha Tsui LCX today
en.dek: The free NOOT NOOT festive installation runs until 3 January at Harbour City's Ocean Terminal third floor, with five photo spots and a limited shop.

zh.headline: Pingu聖誕冰FUN小鎮今日登陸尖沙咀LCX
zh.dek: 免費NOOT NOOT節慶裝置於海港城海運大廈三階展出至1月3日，設五大打卡位及限定店。

en.headline: Police charge 19-year-old student over four mortgage scams totaling HK$3.4 million
en.dek: Yau Tsim officers said the university student posed as a law firm employee, was recruited via Threads for HK$750 per job, and will appear at Kowloon City Magistrates' Courts today.

zh.headline: 警方起訴19歲大學生涉四宗按揭騙局共約340萬元
zh.dek: 油尖警區指該名男學生假扮律師樓職員，透過Threads被招攬每次獲750元報酬，今日在九龍城裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: CE office vehicle strikes pedestrian in Wan Chai, woman declines hospital
en.dek: The Chief Executive's Office said a vehicle turning from Gloucester Road into Fenwick Street about 5:48pm struck a pedestrian who crossed where no at-grade facility exists; she refused treatment and the case was…

zh.headline: 特首辦車輛灣仔遇途人衝出馬路 事主拒絕送院
zh.dek: 行政長官辦公室表示，車輛周三下午約5時48分於灣仔告士打道左轉分域街時，遇到途人在無過路設施路段突然衝出，司機即時煞車報警，事主拒絕送院。

en.headline: Symphony of Lights stages final show over Victoria Harbour
en.dek: The 22-year-old nightly spectacle ended Wednesday at 8pm with rooftop pyrotechnics as WinterFest launched with new district light shows.

zh.headline: 幻彩詠香江最後一場潙演添煙火告別維港
zh.dek: 有二十二年歷史的潙演周三晚上八時上演最後一場，加入屋頂煙火，維多利亞港兩岸超過四十棟大廈配合演出，同時繁紛冬日巡禮啟動。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 0.91 percent lower at 23294.75
en.dek: Hong Kong stocks ended lower on Wednesday as JD Health fell more than 15 percent after results, with main board turnover of about HK$177 billion.

zh.headline: 恒生指數低收0.91% 報政23294.75點
zh.dek: 港股周三低收，京東健康績後挫超15%，主板成交額約1771億元。

en.headline: HK Electric worker suffers burns in North Point switchgear explosion
en.dek: A 28-year-old male employee was taken to Queen Mary Hospital with facial and hand burns after a transformer fault caused a fire at the Electric Centre; he remained conscious.

zh.headline: 北角電燈中心電掣房爆炸 28歲男職員燒傷送院
zh.dek: 一名28歲姓黎男職員在電燈中心因變壓器故障引致火警後，臉部及雙手燒傷，送瑪麗醫院時仍清醒。

en.headline: Parking meter operator to pay HK$1.3 million over citywide outage
en.dek: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said the operator will pay about HK$1.3 million and refund users after a software update disabled roughly 11,000 meters on November 3.

zh.headline: 咪錶營辦商就全城故障向政府賠償約130萬元
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶在立法會表示，營辦商將向政府賠償約130萬元，並向受影響市民退還事故期間收費。

en.headline: Kwong Kau tells High Court he alone dismembered Abby Choi's body
en.dek: The former father-in-law of the slain socialite said he takes full responsibility for disposing of her remains and denied pressuring his elder son to match his evidence.

zh.headline: 鄔球高院稱獨自肢解蔡天鳳遺體並負全責
zh.dek: 蔡天鳳前家翁指事發後決定獨自處理遺體，否認兩名兒子參與，亦否認施壓長子作供配合。

en.headline: Jockey Club Kai Tak Water Sports Centre holds grand opening ceremony
en.dek: The revitalised former fire station facility in Kai Tak hosted athletes and officials on Wednesday, with a parade showcasing dragon boating, rowing and kayaking.

zh.headline: 賽馬會啟德水上運動中心舉行開幕典禮
zh.dek: 由舊啟德消防局活化而成的中心周三舉行開幕典禮，亞運獎牌得主出席，並有共融巡遊展示龍舟及賽艇。

en.headline: Retired executive loses over HK$6 million in pickleball group investment scam
en.dek: Police said a former telecommunications senior manager was contacted via a sports platform pickleball group and transferred funds to a fake investment site for crypto and oil.

zh.headline: 退休電訊高層墮匹克球群組投資騙局損失逾600萬元
zh.dek: 警方指事主在運動平台匹克球群組被私訊搭詔，誤信高回報加密貨幣及原油投資後轉賬至假網站，最終無法提款。

en.headline: Police charge Hailey Cheng with four doxxing offences in MediSafe case
en.dek: Officers charged the whistle-blower this morning with four counts of disclosing personal data without consent causing specified harm; the case goes to Eastern Magistrates’ Court this afternoon.

zh.headline: 藥倍安心風波吹哨者鄭曦琳涉起底罪被控四罪 今午東區裁判法院提堂
zh.dek: 警方周三上午落案起訴鄭曦琳四項「未獲資料當事人同意下披露其個人資料而該披露造成指明傷害」罪，案件今午在東區裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: Hong Kong and Vietnam sign memorandum on international dispute resolution
en.dek: Secretary for Justice Paul Lam and Vietnam’s Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs Le Anh Tuan signed the pact on Wednesday to strengthen capacity-building on economic, commercial and investment disputes.

zh.headline: 港越簽署合作備忘錄 加強國際爭議解決能力建設
zh.dek: 律政司司長林定國與越南外交部副部長黎英俊周三簽署備忘錄，框架涵蓋經濟、商業及投資領域的法律人員能力建設。

en.headline: Lei Yue Mun public toilet wins gold in 2026 Best Public Toilet Awards
en.dek: The Hong Kong Toilet Association named the rebuilt Ling Nam Sun Tsuen facility in Kwun Tong the top toilet, citing its modern design and smart monitoring systems ahead of World Toilet Day.

zh.headline: 鯉魚門嶺南新村公廁奪得2026最佳公廁金獎
zh.dek: 香港廁所協會周三公布結果，觀塘鯉魚門重建公廁憑現代設計及智慧監測系統獲金，適逢世界廁所日。

en.headline: Hong Kong multimillionaires rise 4 percent to 412000 Citibank report says
en.dek: Citibank said the number of residents with at least HK$10 million in net assets reached 412000 by mid-June, up 4 percent year on year, with a median of HK$20 million.

zh.headline: 花旗報告：本港千萬富翁增至41.2萬人 按年升4%
zh.dek: 花旗香港調查顯示，截至今年中，本港總資產淨值至少1000萬元的人士約有41.2萬人，較去年增加4%，中位數為2000萬元。

en.headline: Off-duty police officer sentenced to 120 hours community service for upskirt filming
en.dek: Magistrate Raymond Wong at Shatin Magistrates’ Courts ordered the 39-year-old former officer Ho Ka-chun to complete the service after convicting him over the August 2025 incident at Lai King MTR station.

zh.headline: 時任男警港鐵站偷拍裙底罪成 判120小時社會服務令
zh.dek: 沙田裁判法院裁判官黃國輝周三判處39歲前警員何家俊完成120小時社會服務令，案件涉2025年8月1日荔景港鐵站扶手電梯事件。

en.headline: Cold front to cross Hong Kong later today, temperatures to fall to 15C
en.dek: The Observatory said the front over northern Guangdong will bring rain patches and cooler weather, with urban lows of 15 to 16 degrees on Friday and Saturday.

zh.headline: 冷鋒稍後橫過本港 周五六市區最低約15至16度
zh.dek: 天文台指廣東北部冷鋒今日稍後橫過沿岸，晚上氣溫下降至約21度，隨後顯著轉涼，高地風寒效應明顯。

en.headline: MTR Island Line signalling fault causes rush-hour delays near HKU
en.dek: A fault near HKU station forced slower running and added five to eight minutes to end-to-end journeys on Wednesday morning; services resumed after repairs around 10:30.

zh.headline: 港島線港大站附近信號故障 早高峰延誤近兩小時
zh.dek: 周三早上港大站附近信號設備故障令列車慢駛，來回行車時間多五至八分鐘，北角站出現人龍，約十時半修復後服務逐步回復。

en.headline: Airport Authority option on New World shares faces dilution risk from rights issue
en.dek: Analysts say the authority’s right to buy 750 million shares at HK$3 each, granted in the 11 Skies handover, could lose value after New World’s heavily discounted capital raising.

zh.headline: 機管局認購新世界期權或因供股而攤薄
zh.dek: 分析指機管局以每股3元購入7.5億股的期權，可能因新世界大幅折讓供股而價值受影響，當局未確認有否反攤薄條款。

en.headline: Happy Wednesday Music and Dine Festival returns to Happy Valley tonight
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club’s themed race night at Happy Valley Racecourse features live music by PENTHAÜS, food and drinks in the Beer Garden from 6pm.

zh.headline: 樂嚐星期三今晚重返跑馬地 啤酒園有現場音樂
zh.dek: 香港賽馬會跑馬地馬場主題賽馬夜今晚6時起舉行，啤酒園有PENTHAÜS現場演出及美食飲品。

en.headline: Electoral Affairs Commission holds crisis meeting ahead of Sunday subsector vote
en.dek: Chairman David Lok chaired the session on Tuesday evening to review cybersecurity, security risks and contingency plans for the November 22 elections.

zh.headline: 選管會舉行危機管理會議 為周日選委會選舉作準備
zh.dek: 主席陸啟康周二傍晚主持會議，檢視網絡安全、保安風險及應變計劃，確保11月22日投票日順利。

en.headline: Two arrested at HSBC headquarters over suspected false documents for accounts
en.dek: A 52-year-old man and a 53-year-old woman were detained on Tuesday afternoon after bank staff reported them at the Central building.

zh.headline: 中環滙豐總行兩人涉用假文件開戶被捕
zh.dek: 52歲男子及53歲女子周二下午在皇后大道中滙豐總行被職員舉報後，涉嫌行使虛假文書被警方拘捕。

en.headline: Police arrest two men after seizing drugs from North Point car
en.dek: Officers found about 43 grammes of suspected cocaine and ketamine in a private car outside Tanner Road on Tuesday night; the passenger tried to flee.

zh.headline: 北角私家車檢獲毒品 兩名男子被捕
zh.dek: 警方周二晚上在丹拿道外一輛私家車內檢獲約43克懷疑可卡因及氯胺酮，35歲乘客試圖逃走被制服。

en.headline: Police arrest 67-year-old for flying drone in restricted zone in Tin Shui Wai
en.dek: The man was detained on Tuesday night during the temporary no-fly zone set up for the APEC meetings in Shenzhen; a small drone was seized.

zh.headline: 天水圍67歲男子涉禁飛區放無人機被捕
zh.dek: 警方周二晚上約10時在天水圍拘捕該名本地男子，檢獲小型無人機，案件交元朗警區跟進。

en.headline: Hong Kong WinterFest opens today with multi-district wonderlands
en.dek: The Tourism Board’s flagship event runs to 5 January with Winter Wonderlands in Central and Tsim Sha Tsui from tonight, and the final Symphony of Lights at 8pm.

zh.headline: 香港繽紛冬日巡禮今日開幕 冬日小鎮擴至多區
zh.dek: 旅發局旗艦活動至1月5日，中環及尖沙咀冬日小鎮今晚起開放，幻彩詠香江晚上8時上演最後一場。

en.headline: BIGBANG 20th anniversary media exhibition opens at Festival Walk today
en.dek: The COSMOS show runs from 18 November to 27 December at the Kowloon Tong mall, with themed zones, holograms and official merchandise.

zh.headline: BIGBANG二十周年媒體展《COSMOS》今日於又一城開幕
zh.dek: 展覽由11月18日至12月27日在九龍塘又一城舉行，設主題展區、全息投影及官方周邊。

en.headline: Korean illustration pop-up continues at D2 Place in Lai Chi Kok
en.dek: Eight Korean brands, several making their Hong Kong debut, sell plush toys, charms and stationery at the store until 22 November.

zh.headline: 韓國插畫品牌期間限定店續於荔枝角D2 Place開放
zh.dek: 八個韓國品牌（部分為香港首度登場）於荔枝角D2 Place售賣毛公仔、掛飾及文具，至11月22日止。

en.headline: Abby Choi trial hears Kwong Kau claim he transferred HK$30 million for flat purchase
en.dek: The former father-in-law told the High Court on Tuesday that the money went towards a Kadooria flat registered in his name, and that a large soup pot was intended as a planter.

zh.headline: 蔡天鳳案鄧球作供稱曾轉賬三千萬助購嘉道理山單位
zh.dek: 前家翁周二在高等法院稱款項用於購買以他名義登記的單位，並指大湯煲是用來種植植物。

en.headline: Police arrest 17-year-old over alleged indecent act involving under-16 at Hoi Sham Park
en.dek: Officers detained the youth on Tuesday after investigating videos that circulated online of behaviour at the To Kwa Wan park; the Education Bureau said it is concerned.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕17歲少年 涉向或歲以下兒童作出猾褲行為
zh.dek: 九龍城警區刑事支援隊人員經調查後今日拘捕一名17歲少年，涉土瓜灣海心公園事件，教育局表示極度關注。

en.headline: Airport Authority signs MoU for Tuen Mun sustainable aviation fuel blending facility
en.dek: The agreement with Towngas and EcoCeres advances discussions on a local blending plant to help meet the 2030 target for greener jet fuel.

zh.headline: 機管局與煤氣公司及怡斯萊簽備忘錄 磋商屯門建可持續航空燃料混合設施
zh.dek: 三方同意繼續討論設計、興建及營運事宜，配合政府2030年可持續航空燃料使用目標。

en.headline: CUHK Medical Centre apologises after patient's ovaries removed by mistake
en.dek: A 45-year-old woman had both ovaries taken out during a planned laparoscopic hysterectomy in September; the Department of Health listed it as a sentinel event.

zh.headline: 中大醫院誤切除病人卵巢 院方致歉
zh.dek: 45歲女病人在計劃切除子宮及輸卵管的微創手術中卵巢被誤切，衞生署將事件列為嚴重醫療事故。

en.headline: Fire Services links Shek Kwu Chau incinerator blaze to smoking or welding
en.dek: Investigators ruled out electrical faults, arson and spontaneous combustion after the October 26 No. 3 alarm at I.PARK1; the Environment Protection Department ordered tighter controls.

zh.headline: 消防指石鼓洲焚化廠火警或涉燒焊或吸煙
zh.dek: 調查排除電力故障、縱火及化學自燃，環保署已責成承建商加強熱工序管理及收緊禁煙措施。

en.headline: Police receive 43 reports after two luxury consignment shops close
en.dek: Officers are investigating alleged unpaid consignment proceeds involving about HK$16.6 million after shops in Causeway Bay and Admiralty ceased operations.

zh.headline: 兩間二手名牌寄賣店結業 警方接獲43人報案
zh.dek: 涉及銅鑼灣及金鐘店舖，懷疑拖欠寄賣款項約1660萬元，重案組跟進。

en.headline: Unemployment rate falls to 3.8 percent in August-October period
en.dek: The seasonally adjusted jobless rate edged down 0.1 points while underemployment held at 2 percent, with total employment at 3.65 million.

zh.headline: 8至10月失業率回落至3.8%
zh.dek: 經季節性調整失業率微跌0.1個百分點，就業不足率維持2%，總就業人數約365萬。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 1.03 percent lower at 23,508
en.dek: The benchmark fell 245 points on Tuesday as technology shares remained under pressure, with main-board turnover of about HK$198 billion.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收市跌1.03%報23508點
zh.dek: 大市周二收市跌245點，科技股持續受壓，主板成交額約1981億元。

en.headline: Observatory expects temperatures to fall to 15 degrees by Friday
en.dek: A cold front will cross southern China from Wednesday, bringing northerly winds and cooler conditions, with urban lows of 15 to 16 degrees on Friday and Saturday.

zh.headline: 天文台料周五最低氣溫跌至15度
zh.dek: 冷鋒周三稍後橫過華南沿岸，北風增強，周五及周六市區最低約15至16度，新界相當清涼。

en.headline: Fire at Lam Tin public housing flat injures residents and forces evacuation
en.dek: Blaze at Kai Wong House in Kai Tin Estate started around 1:43pm; firefighters brought it under control in about 20 minutes with preliminary signs of an electrical fault.

zh.headline: 藍田啟田邨啟旺樓單位火警 居民疏散有人受傷
zh.dek: 事發於下午約1時43分，消防員約20分鐘內將火救熄，初步懷疑電路故障或電源排插短路引起。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index down 182 points at midday on tech pressure
en.dek: The benchmark fell as much as 380 points before recovering to 23,571 at noon, with Baidu sliding nearly 7 percent after results.

zh.headline: 恒生指數半日跌182點 科技股受壓
zh.dek: 大市曾跌逾380點，中午報23571點，百度績後急挫近7%，晶片股逆市反彈。

en.headline: Police appeal for information on 77-year-old man missing in Tuen Mun
en.dek: Chow Wah-shun was last seen on Monday afternoon in Tsing Yeung Street; officers described him as 1.68 metres tall with short white hair.

zh.headline: 77歲男子疑在屯門失蹤 警方呼籲提供資料
zh.dek: 鄒華順周一下午最後在青楊街露面，身高約1.68米，蓄短白髮，警方呼籲市民提供線索。

en.headline: Police still probing two-year-old's head injury at Kowloon Tong kindergarten
en.dek: Officers returned to Cannan Kindergarten on Waterloo Road on Monday to collect CCTV, the school said, after earlier claiming the case had been closed.

zh.headline: 九龍塘幼稚園兩歲男童頭部受傷警方仍在調查
zh.dek: 迦南幼稚園（窩打老道）稱警方周一再返回學校取走閉路電視片段，較早前該校曾指案件已結。

en.headline: EGL Tours warns of customer data exposure via third-party supplier
en.dek: The travel agency said names, identity-card numbers and travel-document details of some customers may have been accessed after a supplier reported unauthorised network access.

zh.headline: 東瀛遊接供應商通知系統遭未授權存取 部分客戶證件資料或受影響
zh.dek: 旅行社指第三方技術服務供應商於11月13日通知其後台系統曾遭未經授權存取，部分客戶姓名、身份證及旅遊證件資料可能涉及。

en.headline: Private car hits railing and overturns in Kennedy Town, three unhurt
en.dek: Police said the driver and two passengers climbed out after the car flipped onto its side near Smithfield Municipal Services Building early Tuesday; the driver's breath test read zero.

zh.headline: 堅尼地城私家車撞欄翻側 三人自行爬出幸無受傷
zh.dek: 警方指周二凌晨事發於石山街近士美菲路市政大樓，司機及兩名乘客已自行爬出，酒精測試讀數為零。

en.headline: Disgusting Food Museum continues at Airside until 26 November
en.dek: The Swedish pop-up at Gate33 Gallery in Kai Tak displays more than 80 polarising foods from around the world, with a tasting bar and a vomit bag included with every ticket.

zh.headline: 嘔心食物博物館於啟德AIRSIDE延續至11月26日
zh.dek: 瑞典流行展覽在啟德AIRSIDE的GATE33藝文館展出逾80款爭議美食，門票附送嘔吐袋，並設試食吧。

en.headline: Customs dismantles two illicit cigarette warehouses, seizes HK$1.8 million worth
en.dek: Officers arrested a 56-year-old woman and a 60-year-old man on Monday after raiding storage sites in Yuen Long and Tsuen Wan, seizing about 410,000 duty-not-paid cigarettes.

zh.headline: 海關搗破元朗及荃灣兩個私煙倉檢值180萬
zh.dek: 周一行動中拘捕56歲女子及60歲男子，檢獲約41萬支未完稅香煙，市值約180萬元。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index opens 0.98 percent lower at 23,521
en.dek: The benchmark fell 233 points at the open on Tuesday as tech shares came under pressure, with Baidu sliding after results.

zh.headline: 恒生指數低開0.98%報23521點
zh.dek: 大市周二開市跌233點，科技股受壓，百度績後股價向下。

en.headline: Ventilation duct collapses in Hung Hom Bay Centre carpark, damaging two cars
en.dek: Police said a large duct and concrete fell from the ceiling late Monday night, crushing a Porsche and a Mercedes-Benz with no injuries.

zh.headline: 紅磡灣中心停車場風管塌下壓毀兩車無人受傷
zh.dek: 警方指周一晚約10時41分大型風管連石屎從天花墮下，壓中一輛保時捷及一輛平治，無人受傷。

en.headline: RIMOWA aluminium pop-up continues at Harbour City until 22 November
en.dek: The limited installation in Gateway Arcade traces more than a century of aluminium craftsmanship through four zones, open daily from 11am to 9pm.

zh.headline: RIMOWA鋁製行李箱主題快閃展於海港城延續至22日
zh.dek: 閘道廣場中庭的限時裝置以四個區域追溯逾百年鋁材工藝，每日上午11時至晚上9時開放。

en.headline: White Audi reverses into four taxis while fleeing Tsim Sha Tsui roadblock
en.dek: Police said the driver of a white Audi hit four taxis after being signalled to stop early Tuesday, then fled against traffic; one taxi driver was taken to hospital.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀私家車倒車撞四的士後逆線逃走
zh.dek: 警方指白色Audi司機周二凌晨被截停時突然倒車，撞向四輛的士後逆線逃去，一名的士司機送院。
